description: This plot, titled "ReDial," displays two performance metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—across five distinct values on the x-axis, which are labeled 1 through 5. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Recall@50," ranges from 0.30 to 0.60 in linear increments, while the y-axis on the right, labeled "NDCG@50," ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 in similar increments. The legend indicates three distinct lines: a solid green line with circular markers representing "Recall@50 (Ours)," a solid blue line with square markers representing "NDCG@50 (Ours)," and a dotted blue line with square markers representing "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)." The solid green line begins at approximately 0.35 when x=1 and rises steadily to approximately 0.49 when x=5. The solid blue line starts at approximately 0.32 when x=1 and increases to approximately 0.46 when x=5. The dotted blue line remains constant at approximately 0.16 across all x-values from 1 to 5. The solid green line is consistently above the solid blue line, and both are positioned above the dotted blue line throughout the entire range. The solid green line shows a clear upward trend, while the solid blue line shows a moderate upward trend, and the dotted blue line remains flat.
